description: Rewrite the placeholder Admin component into a real, data-driven reservations operations console under src/admin/, add the Supabase auth gate, the realtime data hook, all admin features, and extend the admin CSS. Wire the new panel into App.tsx in place of the old Admin. Largest feature; depends on FEAT-001 (client/types), FEAT-002 (table/function/realtime source), and FEAT-003 (form conventions). Fails soft when Supabase is not configured.
steps: Create src/admin/adminUtils.ts: initials(firstName,lastName); fullName; a STATUS list (the six canonical German values) with per-status ascii slug ('Ausstehend'->'ausstehend', 'Bestätigt'->'bestaetigt', 'Platziert'->'platziert', 'Storniert'->'storniert', 'Abgeschlossen'->'abgeschlossen', 'No-Show'->'no-show') and badge class `status-<slug>`; date helpers (todayISO, addDays, formatGermanDate); and KPI calculators that take Reservation[] + a day: todaysCount, expectedGuests (sum party_size), pendingCount (status 'Ausstehend'), occupancyPct (platziert count for the day / TOTAL_TABLES, TOTAL_TABLES = 22 documented inline as an assumption, clamp 0..100). No semicolons, double quotes.

Create src/admin/useReservations.ts: a hook that, when isSupabaseConfigured, loads reservations on mount (select ordered by reservation_date, reservation_time) with loading/error/empty flags; subscribes with supabase.channel("reservations").on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "reservations" }, handler) to upsert/remove rows in local state; and removeChannel on cleanup. Expose mutations updateStatus(id,status), assignTable(id,tableNumber), createReservation(payload), remove(id) — each optimistic with rollback on error (keep a snapshot, revert + set error on failure). When not configured, return { configured: false } with empty data and no-op mutations.

Create src/admin/AdminAuth.tsx (default export): dark-theme email/password login card using existing .btn/.btn.primary and field classes, German labels ("E-Mail", "Passwort", "Anmelden"), calls supabase.auth.signInWithPassword, shows a German error on failure and a pending state. Reuse Logo. It is only rendered when configured and there is no session.

Create the admin subcomponents under src/admin/: Kpis.tsx (four real KPI cards reusing .kpis markup), Toolbar.tsx (date nav prev/next/today/tomorrow + date input + 'Alle' toggle; free-text search by name/email/phone; status filter chips/select; seating filter; sort by time / created_at), ReservationRow.tsx (initials avatar, time, party size, seating, table number inline-editable, status badge via status-<slug>, quick contact email/phone on expand, status action buttons), ReservationDrawer.tsx (slide-over/modal showing all fields incl. special_requests, edit + status actions, Stornieren + delete with a confirm step), ReservationForm.tsx ('+ Neue Reservierung' create form reusing field styles, inserts with status 'Bestätigt' since staff created it). Keep every component in the dark aesthetic and German.

Create src/admin/AdminPanel.tsx (default export, props { exit }): manages the Supabase session (supabase.auth.getSession + onAuthStateChange; sign-out button). If !isSupabaseConfigured render a dark 'Supabase nicht konfiguriert' panel (German, with a short hint to set env vars) instead of login/data. Else if no session render <AdminAuth/>. Else render the console: keep the existing left sidebar nav styling; make 'Übersicht' (KPIs + today's list) and 'Reservierungen' (full filterable/sortable list) switch content; render 'Tischplan','Speisekarte','Einstellungen' visibly disabled with a 'Bald verfügbar' hint (no silent dead buttons). Use useReservations for live data with loading/error/empty states. Wire status actions (Bestätigen->'Bestätigt', Platzieren->'Platziert', Stornieren->'Storniert', Als No-Show markieren->'No-Show', Abschließen->'Abgeschlossen') through optimistic updateStatus; inline table assignment through assignTable; detail drawer; '+ Neue Reservierung' through createReservation; delete through remove with confirm. On 'Bestätigen', optionally re-invoke send-reservation-email in a tolerant try/catch (structure it so it is easy; failure never blocks).

Add new Icon paths and widen the Icon name union in src/App.tsx: search, mail, x, refresh, trash, edit, filter (simple SVG stroke paths consistent with the existing 24x24 viewBox style). These are used by the admin components (imported from App or a shared module — if the admin components need Icon, export Icon from App.tsx or move Icon into a shared file and re-import; prefer exporting Icon/Logo from App.tsx with a named export to avoid a large refactor).

Wire App.tsx: replace the old Admin component and its placeholder data (Booking type, initialBookings, the whole Admin function) with the new <AdminPanel exit={() => go("home")} /> imported from "@/admin/AdminPanel". Keep the Footer 'Admin Dashboard' button routing to page 'admin'. Remove now-unused placeholder code to keep the diff clean.

Extend src/index.css under the '/* Admin */' section: add six status badge classes status-ausstehend/-bestaetigt/-platziert/-storniert/-abgeschlossen/-no-show (keep dark palette, distinct colors), plus styles for search input, filter chips/selects, sort control, inline table edit input, the detail drawer/modal + overlay, the new-reservation form, loading/empty/error states, the login gate card, and the disabled 'Bald verfügbar' nav state. Keep bg #171412 / panels #211d1a / borders #352e2a and keep the 1000px/760px/440px responsive breakpoints working.
acceptance_criteria: The admin route renders a real console driven by Supabase data; with no session it shows the German login gate; with no env vars it shows the 'Supabase nicht konfiguriert' panel — in all three cases the app builds and does not crash.
KPIs are computed from loaded data (today's count, expected guests, pending count, occupancy per the documented formula) — no hardcoded numbers remain.

Date nav, search (name/email/phone), status + seating filters, and sort by time/created_at all affect the rendered list; realtime inserts appear without refresh (code path present via postgres_changes).
Status actions, inline table_number edit, detail drawer with delete-confirm, and '+ Neue Reservierung' (inserts as 'Bestätigt') all call the hook mutations with optimistic update + rollback.
No dead/silent nav buttons: Tischplan/Speisekarte/Einstellungen are visibly disabled ('Bald verfügbar').
`pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm build` exit 0; no-semicolon/double-quote/2-space German style preserved; dark aesthetic + breakpoints intact.
verification: Run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm build` — both exit 0.

Read AdminPanel.tsx and useReservations.ts and confirm: isSupabaseConfigured gate renders the German not-configured panel; session gate renders AdminAuth; realtime channel is subscribed and cleaned up; mutations are optimistic with rollback; KPIs come from data not literals.
Read App.tsx and confirm the old Admin/initialBookings/Booking placeholder code is gone and <AdminPanel/> is wired, Icon union/paths include the new names, Footer still routes to admin.
Read the extended '/* Admin */' CSS and confirm the six status-<slug> badges, drawer, filters, login gate, and 'Bald verfügbar' states exist and the three breakpoints still have admin rules.
